text:
alex: Quick heads-up — I'm aiming to land PR #20876 in the 18:00 UTC merge window. CI is currently slow; requesting approvals/eyes and a quick decision on whether we should throttle this or defer to the late slot. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/pr/20876

nina: What's blocking on CI? flaky tests or queue length?

alex: Looks like macOS/e2e matrix is backing up; most unit jobs green. Rebase window closes at 17:30 UTC for the earlier slot. If we need a full rebase it'll push things.

ram: I can kick a targeted rerun for the failing e2e. If it still flakes we should probably defer. Want me to start now?

sre-oncall: FYI queue is ~40% longer than baseline after the infra deploy. Landing during 18:00-19:00 hits a maintenance blackout for some infra tasks — not a hard block but higher risk for restart. :warning:

ci-bot: CI: queued 2 jobs (macos-e2e, integration) for PR #20876 — estimated start ~15m. Logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/20876

nina: If we can run a focused canary (non-prod tag) and verify traffic slices, we could land smaller change set now and follow up with the rest in the later slot.

alex: PR is a single change; we could split but it's messy. I'd prefer to either get green + approvals and land, or delay to 19:15 when queue length should be lower. Thoughts?

ram: Starting the rerun now. I'll post results in 10-12m. If green I can rubber-stamp and merge.

ci-bot: CI: macos-e2e rerun started for PR #20876 (job id: 4521).

deploy-bot: Reminder: planned infra blackout window 18:00-18:45 UTC — automated rollbacks enabled. Recommend avoid risky landings during that window.

sre-oncall: Given the blackout I vote defer unless you need an emergency fix. We've seen spurious restarts during the last blackout.

alex: OK — thanks. Let's wait for the rerun. If ram reports green and no unexpected failures, plan to merge at 18:50 (post-blackout) or else move to 19:15 slot.

ram: Rerun finished — macos-e2e passed, integration still queued but no failures so far. I'm +1 to merge post-blackout but will hold merge until 18:50 as agreed.

nina: I'll give a code + design approval once the integration job finishes or times out cleanly.

alex: Thanks all. Marking this thread as the landing plan: hold during blackout, merge at 18:50 if integration stabilizes, otherwise defer to 19:15. :memo:

ram: noted — will ping again at 18:45 for final thumbs.

sre-oncall: Copy. I'll keep an eye on infra and call out any unexpected restarts.

ci-bot: CI: integration job started for PR #20876 (job id: 4522).

nina: ack — will watch.

alex: Appreciate it — thanks everyone :heart:
